t3.text: New ways to live with a record

s5.text: 02b/02c · Liner notes become editable. Your text replaces what the files carry, for your copy only: an album-keyed override (like the format override), backed up last-write-wins per album, never published to the social layer. Undo the change with Use the notes from the files. Separate from the 140-character sleeve note, which is the one friends can see.

s1.text:
01 · Inside-left cue always shows (it hid on albums without liner notes, hiding Your copy). Rows move 12px → 16px/14px. Format line under the title. The pocket disc is the real pressing, with its dead wax.

02 · THE MASTER block reaches the phone. Credits use tokens, not inline cream. First-spun phase joins the wear line.

03 · Share record sends the whole payload: art, pressing, speed, rating, note, friends.

s2.text:
Size comes from albumFormatFor(): 12″ panel 350px, 10″ 292px, 7″ 204px (the picture sleeve stays for one-track singles). Disc and label sized like real records. Multi-disc gets one pocket per disc, lined up with splitSides(). Back cover: swipe the closed sleeve; sealed records show it through the wrap.

06b/06c · Every record has a back. With no back image of its own, it gets the Miziki default: one ink on plain stock, filled from the tags (sides, times, catalogue, label/year when present). Add your own from the back itself or the edit sheet; Use Miziki default goes back. Stored and synced like a custom cover.

s3.text:
07 · Peel replaces the sealed sheet as the way in.
08 · Long-press (or swipe) a row: Play next, Add to queue, Favorite, the track’s own credits.
09 · Booklet from a sidecar PDF or image folder, page-flip.
10 · After sunset the inside panel keeps notes and the tracklist; Share and Pin wait for morning. Nothing announces it.

s4.text: Desktop’s crate detail panel becomes the gatefold’s wide spread, and the Albums tab and artist drill-downs open the gatefold too. renderAlbumDetail() retires (one in, one out).
